assets.reason: The original packet repeated divine-animal conflations in the mortal hero silhouettes.
assets.promptAddendum: Binding cultural-remediation guardrails: all three canonical heroes are fully human mortals. Khepri-Sen may carry a small scarab-shaped chronometer but has no insect head, carapace, wings or divine body. Taset is a human woman whose Lioness title is an epithet; she has no feline anatomy and no Sekhmet solar disk or cobra. Keep the heroes as the only three human figures, all small secondary silhouettes beside the solar barque and balance. Do not depict any animal-headed god, anthropomorphic scarab, lion woman, monumental seated figure, flanking humanoid statue or giant guardian.
